title: Tank Showdown
desc: Turn-based artillery duel. Five hulls, a ridge of dirt between you, one shot a turn to find the angle.

title: TRAPWIRE
desc: Trap-laying arena brawler for two to four fighters. Six trap types, chain blasts, scan and disarm.

title: Base Defense
desc: Top-down auto-battler. Set the forces and the victory condition, then watch the match fight itself out.

title: Soccer Legends
desc: Arcade football on a single screen.

title: Marble Derby
desc: Marble race down a twisting track. Pick a runner and watch the drop.

title: F1 2026 Tech Explorer
desc: Zoom from the whole 2026 car down to the carbon weave. Fifteen systems, five levels of magnification, eleven teams.

title: World Cup Penalty Shootout
desc: Choose your team and take part in a World Cup penalty shootout.
